title: Did You Watch the Film They Don’t Want You To See? ‘Gaza: Doctors Under Attack’ Is Still Available Globally Via Zeteo
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Over a year ago, we published a documentary that mainstream media didn't want
you to see. A story about Gaza's heroes that the BBC initially [refused to
air](https://zeteo.com/p/exclusive-zeteo-acquiring-film-about). 'Gaza: Doctors
Under Attack' takes you inside [Gaza's hospitals](https://zeteo.com/p/us-
embassy-tells-us-doctor-in-gaza?r=3uiw9m), many of which now lie in ruins,
telling the stories of the [doctors](https://zeteo.com/p/bombs-go-off-as-
mehdi-talks-to-two?r=3uiw9m) who put their lives on the line to save others,
and highlights just how brutal Israel's genocide in Gaza really is.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

As we mark three years since the genocide in occupied Gaza began, not a single
[doctor](https://zeteo.com/p/kidnapped-gaza-doctor-hussam-abu-safiya-life-
threatening-condition?r=3uiw9m) highlighted in this film has seen justice. No
one has been held accountable for the harrowing testimony and evidence of [war
crimes](https://zeteo.com/p/doctors-gaza-humanitarian-foundation-target-
practice?r=3uiw9m) revealed in this documentary, and much of the suffering you
see persists to this day. In August, the United Nations Relief and Works
Agency (UNRWA) described healthcare in occupied Gaza as a "[system in
crisis](https://www.unrwa.org/resources/reports/system-crisis-access-
healthcare-gaza-strip)." As a result of Israel's restriction on aid going into
Gaza, the organization reports that "the presence of a health facility no
longer guarantees that services are operational."

This film was produced by the award-winning Basement Films team that brought
us the **Zeteo** exclusive '[Israel's Reel
Extremism](https://zeteo.com/s/reelisrael).' This comprehensive investigation
examines the systematic targeting of [Gaza's healthcare
system](https://zeteo.com/p/gaza-doctors-israel-arrests-torture?r=3uiw9m),
including all 36 of its main hospitals, multiple times, and the
[killing](https://zeteo.com/p/i-did-not-see-a-ceasefire-american?r=3uiw9m) of
its doctors, nurses, and paramedics.

We are sharing this documentary again because the stories in it are not over.
Help us keep them alive by watching the documentary above and supporting the
work we do in bringing stories like this and much more to our subscribers
across the world.
